speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The chest X-ray showing irregular opacities and airway thickening, combined with your 11-year history of chronic productive cough and recurrent bronchitis, confirms this diagnosis. The sputum culture indicates a secondary bacterial infection, which is common in this condition.
